description: List of items belonging to Abū ʿAlī. Written in a rudimentary hand on a small bifolio. At one point there is a jotting in the shape of a fingerprint in the middle of the text. Mentions linseed oil (zayt ḥār); sugar; sesame oil (sīraj); saffron; olive oil (zayt ṭayyib); honey; qaṭāra; ṭaḥīna; soap (ṣābūn, ghāsūl).
description_he: רשימת פריטים של אבו עלי: שמן, זעפרן וכיוצ״ב.
